title: Dali Museum and Perelada Winery
text: Great tour with Dulce (guide) and Juan Carlos (driver) today. Pickup was well coordinated and on time from our hotel. We had a nice 1.5 hour drive to Figueres with friendly conversation. Dulce provided great information about Dali during the museum visit, making the experience very interesting. We learned a lot.  After a brief lunch at a local restaurant, we were taken to Perelada Winery. The facility was very impressive.  It was an interesting mix of old and new architecture. title: A Dali to remember
text: Dulce was a very thorough interpreter and guide of the Dalí museum. She exposed a fair amount of history to Dali’s life and a lot of his philosophy as well. I fully appreciated her backdrop to his impact of the surrealist movement and Dali’s and Gala’s contribution to the world of Art. Also, the wine portion of the tour was top notch. This is an incredible winery with such a well thought out design and construction. The wine was good, but the winery itself is a masterpiece.
author: 282tiffc

title: Five star tour with great service. If you want to learn about Costa Brava and Dali in depth, this is the tour for you!
text: Dulce met us at our hotel in Barcelona and we were soon on our way to Costa Brava. On the way, Dulce answered some questions we  had about the area which helped us understand the culture more. We also enjoyed the beautiful landscape. Once we arrived at Costa Brava we went for a beautiful scenic walk and enjoyed an amazing view of the Mediterranean. After enjoying the views for a while we headed out for a wine tasting at Viniric Winery.
